newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's NLCF seeks 2,004T pork for Nov shipment.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's NLCF seeks 2,004T pork for Nov shipment.

text.p: South Korea's state-backed National Livestock Cooperative Federation (NLCF) will invite tenders for 2,004 tonnes of pork on Tuesday for November shipment, an official with the federation said on Friday.
The bids must be submitted by 2:00 p.m. (0500 GMT) on October 22 and remain valid until October 29, the official said.
The official said the federation will buy 1,504 tonnes of belly, 300 tonnes of collar and 200 tonnes of rib for shipment by November 20.
Arrivals were set for Seoul and Pusan.
